info.title: AgentaOS Gateway API
info.description:
The AgentaOS REST API: payment links, checkouts, subscriptions, customers, invoices, and the unified transactions feed. This is the same API the TypeScript SDK (`@agentaos/pay`) and the `agenta` CLI call underneath.

## Money model

- **Decimal currency units (`number`)**: a plain `amount` field (on a create body, a Payment Link, a Checkout's `amount_override`, or an Invoice's `amount`/`fiat_amount`/`tax_amount`) is in currency units. `49.99` means EUR 49.99, never cents.
- **Integer minor units (`number`)**: exactly one field breaks that rule: `unitAmountMinor` on a Subscription. It is an integer count of the smallest currency unit (`1999` means EUR 19.99), named with a `Minor` suffix specifically so it is never confused with a plain `amount`. The `money` object on Transactions and the `earnings` object on a retrieved Invoice are also integer minor units, computed server-side.
- **String, on webhooks**: the `amount` inside a webhook payload's `data` object is a string (e.g. `"49.99"`), since JSON numbers silently drop trailing zeros and this value must round-trip exactly for accounting.

## Naming convention

Most response fields mirror the underlying database column and are `snake_case` (`created_at`, `seller_mode`, `buyer_email`, ...). A small number of computed convenience fields are camelCase with no snake_case equivalent: `checkoutUrl` on Checkouts and Payment Links, `sellerMode` on Payment Links specifically, `money` on Transactions, and `earnings` on a single retrieved Invoice. Two resources (Subscriptions and Customers) are fully camelCase end to end.

## Pagination

Every list endpoint takes `limit` and `offset` and returns `{ items, total, hasMore }`. `hasMore` is computed server-side (`offset + items.length < total`); never derive it client-side.

tags.name: Payment Links
tags.description: Reusable, shareable payment products: a fixed amount and description behind one URL.

tags.name: Checkouts
tags.description: One attempt to collect one payment, standalone or built from a payment link. Wire path is `/gateway/sessions`; the SDK and CLI call this resource "checkout".

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Merchant-side read and management surface for recurring plans. Created automatically when a buyer pays a `type: subscription` payment link.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Read-only surface: everyone who has paid you or been sent an invoice.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Every checkout issues an invoice. List, retrieve, void, export, and download PDFs/receipts.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: The unified activity feed: every inbound payment and outbound send, across every rail, in one list.

post.description: Creates a reusable, shareable payment link.

get.description: Paginated. See the Money model / Pagination notes on this spec's top-level description.
Same fields as create, plus `transactions`: every payment (inbound or outbound) recorded against this link, newest first, same row shape as a Transaction but without the computed `money` breakdown.

200.description: The payment link, with its transaction history.

patch.description: Partial update: only send the fields you want to change.

delete.description: Deactivates the link. Existing checkouts already in progress are unaffected; no new checkout can be started from it afterward. This is a state change, not a delete: the link and its payment history stay readable.

post.description: Creates a checkout session, standalone or built from a payment link with `linkId`. The create and list responses do **not** include a plain `amount`, only `amount_override` (`null` unless you passed one). Call "Retrieve a checkout" for a computed, ready-to-display `amount`. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header (wins over a body `idempotencyKey` if both are sent); a repeat call with the same key returns the same checkout instead of creating a second one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Alternative to the body's `idempotencyKey` field. The header wins if both are sent.

get.description: Paginated. Same fields as create, per item.

Adds a computed `amount` (the effective price: `amount_override`, else the linked payment link's amount), plus the link's own `link_amount`/`link_currency`/`link_description`, and the checkout's `transactions` and `invoices` arrays.

200.description: The checkout, with computed amount and related rows.

post.description: Stops the buyer from paying. If a payment already cleared before the cancel call lands, it still completes: cancelling doesn't reach into the card processor or on-chain state after the fact. Only works while the checkout is `open` (`400` otherwise).

get.description: Paginated. A subscription is created automatically when a buyer pays a payment link with `type: "subscription"` at checkout: there is no `POST` create endpoint by design. Every field on this resource is camelCase on the wire.

post.description: Cancels at the end of the current paid period by default: the subscriber keeps what they already paid for, no refund. Pass `atPeriodEnd: false` to cancel immediately instead. Calling cancel again on an already-`canceled` subscription is a no-op. Returns `400` if the subscription never completed a first successful charge (`stripeSubscriptionId` is `null`).

get.description: Quote moving a subscription to another plan. Read-only: nothing is charged or scheduled. The target must be a different subscription product in the same currency and billing interval, and the subscription must be `active` or `trialing`. An upgrade (higher price) is charged now, prorated; a downgrade switches at the current period end with nothing due today. Pass the returned `prorationDate` to the apply call so the charge matches this quote.

200.description: The quote. Money fields are integer minor units.

post.description: Apply a plan change quoted by the preview. Echo the preview's `prorationDate` so the amount charged matches the quote. An upgrade charges the prorated difference on the saved card now and the response carries the new per-cycle amount; a downgrade is scheduled for the current period end (`effectiveAt`) and charges nothing today. Idempotent on (subscription, target plan, prorationDate). Same plan, a non-active subscription, a different currency, or a different billing interval return `400`.

200.description: The applied change. Shape depends on `direction`.

get.description: Paginated, newest first, no filters beyond pagination. A customer record is created automatically the first time someone pays you (or you issue them an invoice) with an email attached. There is no `POST` create endpoint: this is a read-only surface. Every field on this resource is camelCase on the wire.

Paginated. Every checkout issues an invoice: `issued` the moment the checkout is created, `paid` once the payment settles, or `voided` if cancelled. The seller of record is our Estonian entity, AgentaOS's Merchant of Record entity, unless the payment settled to your own on-chain wallet (`seller_mode: "crypto"`), in which case you're the seller.

A statement-style PDF covering a date range: opening/closing balance, every transaction in the ledger, and a VAT summary grouped by rate. `from` and `to` are both required, unlike the other date filters in this API.

Up to 5000 rows for the matching filter, built for accounting software: date, invoice number, description, amount and currency, exchange rate and source, tax name/rate/amount, buyer name/company/country/VAT, and status.

Same fields as the list, plus `earnings`: a fee/VAT/net breakdown, present only for a card/bank Merchant-of-Record sale with a linked, settled transaction. `null` otherwise (crypto sales, or a not-yet-paid `issued` invoice).

200.description: The invoice, with its earnings breakdown.

post.description: Marks the accounting record void. It never touches the payment itself: if the buyer already paid, nothing is refunded. Use it to correct a bookkeeping mistake, not to reverse a charge. Irreversible: there is no "un-void"; an already-voided invoice returns `400` on a repeat call.

get.description: Response is `application/pdf` (binary), not JSON. Includes seller and buyer details, the amount (plus fiat equivalent and exchange rate for stablecoin payments), and a tax breakdown.

Same document family as the invoice PDF, but titled as a receipt with its own receipt number, for a **paid** invoice. Falls back to the plain invoice PDF (still valid proof of payment) for invoices issued before receipts existed on your account, rather than `404`ing.

200.description: The receipt PDF (or the invoice PDF, on fallback).

post.description: Sends the paid receipt to the buyer email on file. Only works for a `paid` invoice with a `buyer_email`: returns `400` otherwise.

get.description: One unified list of everything that moved money on your account: inbound payments (from checkouts and payment links) and outbound sends, across every rail (card, SEPA bank transfer, stablecoins on-chain), in one feed. Only `confirmed` rows are returned: a pending or failed attempt never appears here; `status` on each item is always `confirmed`.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your secret key, from app.agentaos.ai -> Settings -> Developers -> API Keys. The key's prefix is both its identity and its environment: `sk_test_...` (sandbox, free, no verification) or `sk_live_...` (real money, requires business verification). A missing or invalid key returns 401.

SubscriptionId.name: id
SubscriptionId.description: Subscription UUID (the `id` field from the list response, not `stripeSubscriptionId`).

Limit100.name: limit
Limit100.description: Items per page. Capped server-side at 100.

Limit5000.name: limit
Limit5000.description: Items per page. Capped server-side at 5000.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of items to skip, for the next page.

NetworksFilter.name: networks
NetworksFilter.description: Comma-separated CAIP-2 network IDs to filter by, e.g. `eip155:8453,eip155:84532`. Ignored if your API key is network-scoped.

From.name: from
From.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, inclusive lower bound.

To.name: to
To.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, inclusive upper bound.

FiatCurrency.name: fiatCurrency
FiatCurrency.description: Filter to rows settled/presented in this fiat currency.

BadRequest.description: A required field is missing, out of range, or the wrong type. `ValidationPipe` also rejects any field not in the documented schema.

example.message: amount is required when creating a session without a link

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but the resource belongs to a different organization.

example.message: Payment link belongs to another organization

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or not visible to your key; the two are not distinguished).

Conflict.description: The resource was modified concurrently, or the action doesn't apply to its current state.

Error.description: Every non-2xx response is JSON in this shape. Every response (success or error) also carries an `x-request-id` response header; send that header on your request to have your own id echoed back, otherwise the server mints one. On errors the same id is repeated in the `requestId` body field.

statusCode.description: Same as the HTTP status code.

message.description: Human-readable. A validation failure (400) returns an array of per-field messages instead of one string.

errors.description: Present on 400 validation failures: one entry per invalid field. The flat human-readable strings stay in `message` for back-compat; this is the machine-readable, per-field view.

field.description: Name of the invalid field, dot-notated for nested properties (e.g. `checkoutFields.0.type`).

message.description: Validation messages for that field, joined with `, `.

requestId.description: Correlation id, identical to the `x-request-id` response header. Include it when contacting support. On success it is available on the header only, not the body.

CheckoutField.description: An extra field collected at checkout.

currency.description: Defaults to your org's settlement currency. A fiat code is mapped to your org's default settlement token internally; the link stores the resolved token.

name.description: Product name, for the catalog-style link surfaces. Separate from `description`.

type.description: A `subscription` link requires `billingInterval` and settles on the card/bank rail (Merchant of Record); it can't be a crypto-settlement link.

billingInterval.description: Required when `type` is `subscription`, must be omitted for `one_time`.

trialPeriodDays.description: Free-trial length in days. Subscription links only. The buyer's card is saved with nothing due today; the first charge happens when the trial ends.

maxUses.description: 1 for single-use, N for a limited quantity, omitted for unlimited.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data, returned unchanged on webhooks. Up to 8KB serialized.

supportedNetworks.description: CAIP-2 network IDs (e.g. eip155:8453), for crypto-settlement links. Ignored (and taken from your key's configuration instead) if your API key is scoped to specific networks.

PaymentLinkUpdateRequest.description: Partial update. Every field is optional; only fields present are changed.

type.description: Checked against the resulting merged state.

trialPeriodDays.description: Free-trial length in days; subscription links only.

secure_link_id.description: Public ID used in the checkout URL.

payment_count.description: Successful payments against this link so far.

seller_mode.description: mor (card + bank) or crypto (on-chain). The snake_case column equivalent of the computed `sellerMode`.

checkoutUrl.description: Full URL to share with buyers. Computed, camelCase, no snake_case equivalent.

LinkTransactionRow.description: A raw transaction row as nested under a Payment Link or Checkout detail response: same shape as a Transaction, but without the computed `money` breakdown.

transactions.description: Every payment (inbound or outbound) recorded against this link, newest first.

CheckoutCreateRequest.description: Either `linkId` or `amount` is required (amount is required when creating a standalone checkout with no link).

linkId.description: Payment link UUID to create from. Inherits amount, currency, description, taxRateId, and the seller mode. Omit for a standalone checkout.

amountOverride.description: With linkId, overrides the link's amount for this checkout only.

currency.description: Ignored (inherited from the link) when linkId is set.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Presentation only, stamped onto the invoice issued for this checkout.

buyerCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. DE. Drives destination-VAT calculation.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until expiry. Sessions eligible for SEPA bank transfer get a 48-hour window regardless of this value.

supportedNetworks.description: CAIP-2 network IDs. Defaults to Base mainnet for crypto-settlement checkouts.

idempotencyKey.description: Also settable via the Idempotency-Key request header (the header wins if both are sent).

session_id.description: Public ID, used in the checkout URL and as the path parameter for every other call on this resource.

amount_override.description: Set only if you passed amount or amountOverride at create.

checkoutUrl.description: Send your buyer here. Computed, camelCase.

invoiceId.description: Set once an invoice has been issued for this session; null until then.

amount.description: Computed effective price: amount_override, else the linked payment link's amount.

id.description: Use this as the :id path parameter to cancel.

planName.description: The payment link's name, falling back to its description.

status.description: Mirrored directly from the card processor.

unitAmountMinor.description: Per-cycle price, integer minor units (1999 = EUR 19.99).

currentPeriodEnd.description: null before the first cycle books.

atPeriodEnd.description: true schedules the cancellation for period end. false cancels now.

PlanChangePreview.description: Read-only quote for moving a subscription to another plan. Money is integer minor units.

direction.description: `upgrade` when the new plan costs more per cycle, otherwise `downgrade`.

dueTodayMinor.description: Charged now. Always 0 for a downgrade.

effectiveAt.description: Upgrade: now. Downgrade: the current period end.

nextInvoiceMinor.description: The next regular cycle invoice on the new plan.

prorationDate.description: Unix seconds. Echo it in the apply request so the charge matches this quote.

effectiveAt.description: When the new plan starts: the current period end.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, the customer's place of supply for destination-VAT purposes.

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number, if given, for B2B reverse charge.

stripeCustomerId.description: null until this customer's first saved-card charge or subscription (card/bank rail only).

payment_token.description: What the buyer paid (or will pay) with.

status.description: issued (created, not yet paid), paid (payment settled), or voided.

Earnings.description: Merchant-only fee/VAT/net breakdown, integer minor units in `currency`. grossMinor is your ex-VAT sale base (agentaosFeeMinor + netMinor); the buyer paid grossMinor + vatMinor.

earnings.description: Present only for a card/bank Merchant-of-Record sale with a linked, settled transaction. null otherwise.

TransactionMoney.description: Render-ready breakdown, computed server-side so you never sum this yourself. All values integer minor units in money.currency.

grossMinor.description: Your ex-VAT sale base (feeMinor + netMinor). The buyer paid grossMinor + vatMinor.

feeMinor.description: AgentaOS's commission alone, 0 when none. Never includes VAT.

vatMinor.description: Destination VAT AgentaOS collected and remits as Merchant of Record. On top of grossMinor, never your revenue.

netMinor.description: What actually reaches your balance (grossMinor - feeMinor).

Transaction.description: This row carries additional internal ledger fields (settlement batch references, dispute markers, raw card-processor fee) beyond what's documented here. Treat any undocumented field as forward-compatible and safe to ignore.

amount.description: Presentment amount, currency units, in payment_token/settlement_token.

payment_token.description: What the buyer paid with, e.g. EURC, card.

payment_method.description: How the buyer actually paid, independent of network.

payer_address.description: On-chain payer wallet. null for card/bank rails.

tx_hash.description: null for card/bank rails, use vendor_reference there instead.

vendor_reference.description: Off-chain audit reference (card-processor payment reference, bank reference). Mutually exclusive with tx_hash.

network.description: CAIP-2 network ID for on-chain rails, or stripe for card/bank.

seller_of_record.description: aristokrates_ou for a Merchant of Record card sale, merchant for everything else.

invoice_id.description: The matching invoice, joined for convenience. null for outbound rows.
